entities.name: Hiram Bingham I
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hiram Bingham, formally Hiram Bingham I, was the leader of the first group of American Protestant missionaries to introduce Christianity to the Hawaiian Islands. Like most of the missionaries, he was from New England.
